ruralpop_count|department.reason: FENCED by V2_PLAN decision 3. Rows stay in master; excluded from the published catalog. Unlike the series already rendering from this file, this one was never exposed, so fencing it needs no withdrawal.

tonnage_entered|national.reason: Not a source-line defect. The series carries two incompatible scales: 24 cells read 5,483 to 14,965 and 8 read 3.69M to 24.6M, and it is the MILLIONS that are right — 1907 entered 24,645,751 against tonnage_cleared 24,159,898 the same year, while the small limb is off by three orders of magnitude. Every million-scale cell carries needs_review, so G1b withholds exactly the correct values and publishes only the corrupt ones. G6 cannot catch it either: with the correct limb stripped the survivor climbs 5,483 to 14,965 with no step over 10x. Publishing this would ship a wrong series through green gates. Re-audit the small limb against the printed cuadro before reconsidering.

salario_mensual_registrado_domestic_help.reason: Every row is annotated `Escudos de cada año`, but the escudo did not exist until 1960 and the series starts in 1944, so the unit label cannot hold across the whole run. The values break at the 1975 currency reform: 1,548 in 1973 against 9.83 in 1974. G1b withholds the three needs_review cells of 1971-73, which leaves a published series that steps straight from 4.40 in 1958 to 9.83 in 1974 across a sixteen-year gap and two currency reforms with no break annotation and no step large enough for G6 to see. Same class as the seven unit_splice_corruption series already withheld. Needs the deflator and the reform boundary before it publishes.

occupation_total|province.reason: The geographic_unit on these rows is an OCCUPATION (`Abogados, procuradores, escribanos`, `Costureras`, `Eclesiásticos...`), not a province. These are the NATIONAL 1854 occupational totals mislabelled as province-level — the same dimension-wearing-a-geography defect as the partner-country trade series (chunk 4.3). Nothing resolves to a province key, so nothing renders. Re-key as national occupation variables, then expose.
